BiblicalUsage: The incense burned in the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem — by the people, their fathers, their kings and their princes — is the charge Jeremiah brings. The word is the perfume itself, and God did not forget it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers incense burned to other gods, and Jeremiah says it came into his mind.
